ARABIC — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: ARABIC
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Imitative Speaking: Pronunciation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Imitative Speaking: Pronunciation.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Imitative Speaking: Pronunciation.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Imitative Speaking: Pronunciation.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Imitative Speaking: Pronunciation.

2. When practising Phonological Awareness, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   C. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness.

3. In ARABIC, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Only memorise without using the language
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Mix random languages with no purpose

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Gist.

7. When practising Conversational Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Use insults to “practise” Conversational Skills.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Conversational Skills.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Conversational Skills.

8. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)

----
